title: Surprisal-R\'enyi Free Energy
abstract: arXiv:2603.03405v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The forward and reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergences arise as limiting objectives in learning and inference, yet they induce markedly different inductive biases that cannot be explained by expectation terms alone. We introduce the Surprisal-R\'enyi Free Energy (SRFE), a normalized R\'enyi-Chernoff log-moment functional of the likelihood ratio. Although SRFE is algebraically related to R\'enyi divergence for fixed values of the order parameter, its endpoint-symmetric normalization yields a distinct free-energy viewpoint for analyzing how forward- and reverse KL behavior emerges near singular limits. We show that SRFE recovers the forward and reverse KL divergences as endpoint limits and derive local expansions around both regimes in which the variance of the log-likelihood ratio appears as a first-order correction away from the KL objective. translated_abstract: 前向与反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度在学习与推理中作为极限目标而出现，然而它们会诱导出显著不同的归纳偏置，这一点无法仅凭期望项加以解释。我们提出了惊异-雷尼自由能，它是似然比的一个归一化雷尼-切尔诺夫对数矩泛函。尽管对于固定的阶参数取值，SRFE在代数上与雷尼散度相关联，但其端点对称的归一化提供了一个独特的自由能视角，可用于分析前向与反向KL行为如何在奇异极限附近涌现。我们证明SRFE在端点极限下分别恢复出前向与反向KL散度，并推导了在这两种情形附近的局部展开，其中对数似然比的方差作为偏离KL目标的一阶修正项出现。这些展开揭示了一个显式的均值-方差权衡，支配着对KL目标的偏离。
tldr: 本文提出惊异-雷尼自由能（SRFE）这一似然比的归一化雷尼-切尔诺夫对数矩泛函，证明其在端点极限下恢复前向与反向KL散度，并通过局部展开揭示了对数似然比方差作为一阶修正所体现的均值-方差权衡机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Surprisal-Rényi Free Energy (SRFE), a normalized Rényi-Chernoff log-moment functional of the likelihood ratio that recovers the forward and reverse KL divergences as endpoint limits and reveals, through local expansions, an explicit mean-variance tradeoff in which the variance of the log-likelihood ratio emerges as a first-order correction away from the KL objective.
